Ratpack errors can lose exception reporting when controller telemetry is disabled. This registers the channel-derived request context even when no handler span starts, independently of the signal-selection changes in #20648.

- **Context ownership:** Preserve handler-span error targets when enabled. Omit the current-context fallback: supported callbacks retain the request registry, while thread-current context may belong to another request.
- **Coverage:** Add disabled-controller JVM variants alongside existing enabled suites, covering synchronous, blocking, overlapping async, and forked errors, including request attribution, route naming, and callback parentage.
metadata.title: Fix Ratpack error reporting when no handler span starts
